name: Surrozen, Inc.
summary: Surrozen, Inc., a biotechnology company, discovers and develops product candidates to selectively modulate the Wnt pathway for tissue repair. Its lead product candidates are antibody-based therapeutics that target various disease areas, including diseases of the eye, intestine, liver, lung, retina, kidney, cochlea, cornea, skin, pancreas, and central nervous system.
